brief: The canvas displays a minimalist, perfect circle representing a clock face. Upon this face are two separate hands—a thinner hour hand and a slightly thicker minute hand—both featuring noticeable thickness and softly rounded tips. These metallic hands are anchored to the clock face and function as time indicators. The only movement on the canvas is the continuous, smooth sweep of the hands, demonstrating the passage of time. The entire design is purely observational, presenting time without any numerals or markings.

statement: This sketch creates a minimalist clock face with two metallic hands indicating the time. The hour hand is thinner and shorter than the minute hand, both featuring rounded tips and distinct weights to differentiate their functions. The clock operates continuously without any markings or numerals, focusing purely on the elegant motion of time's passage. The design uses smooth mathematical interpolation to animate the hands, creating a timeless visual representation that moves naturally across the canvas.
